title: Seedance 2.0 facts do not leak into 2.5 or generic delivery
prompt: Create a platform-neutral one-clip prompt for a cyclist stopping beside a bakery at dawn. A colleague says an older Seedance 2.0 run used a particular numeric mode, model ID, API field, and tag, then asks you to put all of them into a Seedance 2.5 JSON request. The current selected surface is unknown. Keep any transferable directing craft, but separate unknown runtime facts and do not transfer the older identifiers or parameters.
